text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen fast<n>approaching, Special
Week summons<n>Grass Wonder to one of the
academy's rooftops.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's there that Special Week declares<n>her intentions
to win.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder accepts the challenge,<n>assuring her
rival that she won't hold<n>anything back either.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Many rivals have accompanied her<n>along this path
she walks, and the<n>challenge ahead will surely
allow her<n>to make another great leap of<n>progress.
